description: Create, modify, or delete an IRIS scheduled task. For 'create', name, taskClass, and namespace are required. For 'modify', id is required and only provided fields are updated. For 'delete', only id is needed.

action.description: Action to perform on the task

namespace.description: Target namespace for task execution (required for create)

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_task_manage
title: Manage Task
